_comment: Thresholds and word lists for qc_check.py. client_names (stakeholder names that must not appear on a slide) and active_client_palette are set per engagement in a local copy.

brief._note: One-slide Build Brief. Dense by design and approved as such. Hygiene, author field, placeholders and number checks still apply; page-density rules do not. Inferred when a deck is one slide headed 'Build Brief'.

_gate_exclude_note: Path fragments qc_gate_hook.py never gates: fixtures, templates' asset folders, and the .qc.pptx output of --fix-safe (gating it cascades a second block on what --fix-safe could not fix).
_totals_note: totals-sum fires only when components miss the stated total by more than 1 and by at most totals_window_pct of it (or 5 units); a wider miss means the Total is a different quantity, such as a crosstab total column.
_client_palettes_note: Empty by design. Brand colours are read from the client template's own theme part (clrScheme and custClrLst), so no per-engagement switch is needed and none can be left set to the wrong client. Add an entry here only to override the typeface allowlist (fonts) for an engagement, and set active_client_palette to its key; colours go under a 'colors' key.
_expand_note: Per engagement. A single capitalised token at the start of a paragraph (a chart label, a sentence opener) is never flagged. On the shipped federal deck the consultant kept HHS, DoD, VA, DHA and CMS as written and spelled out only DOE and, in one quote attribution, DHA; a default list of federal agencies produced 10 ignored warnings, so the default is short.
_italics_note: The italics check was removed on 2026-09-23 (owner ruling): italics are the author's call. Grey text outside footnotes is listed for judgment and never blocks; above the threshold it warns. Rationale: title, body or footnote should carry everything a reader needs in a five-second scan; recurring small italic or grey detail text is the AI habit that works against it.
_words_note: Per body page: title + body + chart labels, footnotes counted separately, appendix pages exempt. Pages where half or more of the words sit inside quotation marks are exempt (quote pages). Set 2026-09-12 from the shipped minipack (typical 160-210) and public sector deck (typical 130-250); the one page above 300 drew the comment 'wordy'. Warn only since 2026-09-23 (owner ruling): length is the consultant's call, so the gate never blocks on it.
_tolerances_note: overlap_tolerance_pt: two text or chart boxes may intersect by this much before shape-overlap fires. chart_label_tolerance: a data label figure must sit within this of a cached value; labels that also carry words (n=120, 2024) warn rather than block.
